author: reek
body: First slice of the bounds-prover reach campaign: a value expression built from literal-defined constants proves its range at a bounded store, so the CDX2051 silent-truncation warning is elided and the CDX2053 proven info is reported instead. Covers the expression shapes the checker-side analysis recognizes -- a constant name, an if-expression joining two constants, a let body, and a constant in ctor-payload and __record-set position. The deliberately unprovable store (a plain parameter) is rejected since CDX2051 became an error; its twin lives in errors/narrowing-unproven. The sidecars assert the proven diagnostic and the in-range runtime behavior.
